Definition: to broaden (intransitive or transitive, literal or figurative)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be or grow wide, be or grow large; 1a) (Qal) to be widened, be enlarged; 1b) (Niphal) broad or roomy pasture (participle); 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to make large; 1c2) to enlarge
